how: Growing Underground offers 75-minute guided tours of its hydroponic LED-lit farm in a Second World War shelter 33 m below Clapham; visits only, not hands-on growing.
The Herts & Middlesex branch of Butterfly Conservation runs free guided butterfly walks open to all levels, including walks in London boroughs and Wanstead Flats, with booking via Eventbrite.
Soho has dedicated sneaker shops such as Footpatrol on Berwick Street, size? on Carnaby Street and END. on Broadwick Street, selling hyped and limited releases.
Benjamin Pollock's Toy Shop in Covent Garden sells vintage and retro toys and toy theatres, and Pollock's Toy Museum runs shop and display sites in Leadenhall Market and Croydon.

Enthusiast guides name London spotting spots such as Clapham Junction, Stratford, Willesden Junction, Kensington Olympia and Wandsworth Road, where photographing trains from public platforms is normally permitted.
The Watch Collectors' Club holds free regular watch meetups in Central London where members show their collections, plus retailer evenings and vintage watch events.
